newsitem.title: UK: Anite Group firms after unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Anite Group firms after unit sale.

text.p: Shares in Anite Group Plc firmed in active trading after the UK data communicaitons concern said it sold its Case Technology Denmark unit to Intel Europe Inc for about 42 million stg ($72 million), dealers said.
The shares were up 4-1/2p to 45p by 0855 GMT. Almost 1.9 million shares traded, placing them on London's most active list.

The proposed sale completes Anite's exit from data communications product manufacturing which generated total net proceeds of 45 million stg. Those businesses incurred operating losses of 23 million in the last fiscal year, Anite said.
The remaining units in Anite Group will consist of two business units, Anite Systems and Anite Networks, and will focus on its software and network integration activities, it said.
"They got rid of the loss makers and that's good news for the company," said one market maker.
In the trading statement issued this morning, Anite posted a pre-tax pre-exceptional loss of 38.6 million stg in the six months ended October 31, 1996.
"Their figures are poor but you have to look at the future of the company and now it looks like Anite is in shape to prosper," said another market maker.
